685.s: “As I grew older I began to twist my turban into richer folds, and to give an extra turn to my girdle; for as I walked through the bazār to operate upon some of our wealthier employers at their own houses, I not unfrequently caught the low murmur of admiration which stole from beneath the yashmacs of the women as I passed them; and I learned to understand that my personal advantages far outran my fortunes.
